properties.description:
`scan_nodes` takes `level` — component / subsystem / system / system_of_systems / enterprise — so "what are the top-level boxes?" is one call with one answer. It refuses an unknown rung, and refuses `level` on any type other than Component rather than returning an empty list, because "no Components at that rung" and "that is not a rung" are different facts and the second silently reads as the first. A node with no level answers to `component`, matching the schema default, so older nodes are not lost by the filter.

WHY IT IS A CAPABILITY AND NOT A CONVENIENCE: the field was indexed and populated all along, and with no way to ask by it every caller derived the top tier from the containment spine — which returns leaves nobody wired to a parent. Measured on this design: 8 subsystems by declared level, 2 leaves by spine position.
properties.name: Ask for one rung of the decomposition ladder directly, instead of deriving it from the containment spine
